title: Local finite-free source model and joint degree-one comparison square
statement: Choose shared derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S and fi:Xi→S be flat proper morphisms locally of finite presentation, with ui:Xi→X over S, and assume universal isomorphisms of the tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction units [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let L be invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], k:W→S an immersion, w in W, s=k(w). Assume the target pullbacks of L over W and the source pullback on Spec kappa(s) descend from finite locally free modules [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. There exist an affine neighbourhood U of w, nonnegative m,q, d in A^m for A=Gamma(W,U), b:A^m→A^q, and a connective strictly perfect complex K of modules on the localized site over U [def-pc-perfect-complex]. There are linear section bases e0:Gamma(K^0)≅A and e1:Gamma(K^1)≅A^m, and a derived isomorphism hE identifying K with the restriction of the derived direct image of the base-changed L [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every a, e1(d_K^0(e0 inverse(a)))=a d; evaluation at w kills each coordinate of d, and b(d)=0. For p=ker(A→kappa(w)) with its canonical prime instance [def-weil-residue-field], there are an additive equivalence alpha:kappa(p) tensor_A A^m≅H^1(X_s,O) and an additive map beta:kappa(p) tensor_A A^q→product_i H^1(Xi_s,O) such that beta((b tensor kappa(p))(z)) is exactly the family of canonical cohomology pullbacks of alpha(z) [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. No H-one injectivity is assumed and no section-realization assertion is concluded.

proof.text: Base change to W. The unit on every residue-field structure module excludes an empty fibre: pushforward from the empty scheme is zero whereas the field structure module is nonzero. At a point of each fibre, a local finite-free basis of the descended target module pulls back to a free basis; its dimension must be one since the pulled-back bundle is invertible. Thus its local rank at w is one. Choose common target trivializations and an affine neighbourhood. Over the source residue field, apply the field rank-one trivialization theorem to hLs, then identify the marked fields by the immersion.

Invertible modules on the flat source and targets are finitely presented and relatively flat. Apply perfect direct-image base change and finite-free residue models to their derived direct images. Use a common affine refinement of these models; negative Betti numbers are zero, so all negative terms vanish. Degree zero has rank one. The residue dimension of each term equals its cohomology dimension, hence every residue differential vanishes. Choose section bases e0 and e1 of the source degrees zero and one and define d by the coordinates of d-zero(1). This yields hd and hdw, the strictly perfect K and its comparison hE.

Represent each derived pullback arrow to the targets by an actual chain map. Each global target trivializing section gives a cycle whose coefficient has nonzero residue in the rank-one degree-zero term. Invert these finitely many coefficients on a smaller common affine neighbourhood. Their differentials are zero, so the target degree-zero differentials vanish. In finite-free degree-one bases form the joint map b. The chain equations give b(d)=0.

The affine evaluation kernel is prime by RingHom.ker_isPrime, and its residue field is canonically kappa(w). Minimality identifies residue degree-one terms with fibre H-one. Use the source fibre generator to obtain alpha; on each target adjust its fibre trivialization by the scalar comparing it with the pulled-back source generator. Canonical base change and the affine higher-direct-image/cohomology comparison identify the residue chain maps with the canonical structure-sheaf H-one pullbacks, giving the displayed square with beta. For an empty target family use q=0 and the unique map; for m=0 alpha identifies the zero term with zero H-one. No joint-injectivity hypothesis is used.

    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) {n : ℕ}
    (Xi : Fin n → Scheme.{v}) (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [∀ i, Flat (fi i)] [∀ i, IsProper (fi i)] [∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (fi i)]
    (ui : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hui : ∀ i, ui i ≫ f = fi i)

      IsIso ((Classical.choose

          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hOi : ∀ i, ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd (fi i) g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLi : ∀ i, ∃ (N : W.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (fi i) k)).obj

    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N)) :
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U), IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ (m q : ℕ) (d : Fin m → Γ(W, U))

        (K : CochainComplex

        IsStrictlyPerfect W U K ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
        ∃ (e0 : (K.X 0).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] Γ(W, U))
          (e1 : (K.X 1).val.obj (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) ≃ₗ[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U))),
          Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
            (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
                  (SheafOfModules.{v}
                    (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
                      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ∧
          (∀ a : Γ(W, U), e1 ((K.d 0 1).val.app (.op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (e0.symm a)) = a • d) ∧
          (∀ i, W.evaluation U w hwU (d i) = 0) ∧ b d = 0 ∧
          let p := RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
          letI : p.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom
            ∃ (α : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)] (Fin m → Γ(W, U))) ≃+
                Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb (pullback f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)
              (β : (p.ResidueField ⊗[Γ(W, U)] (Fin q → Γ(W, U))) →+

                  (structureSheafAb (pullback (fi i) (S.fromSpecResidueField s))) 1)),

                structureSheafCohomologyPullback

                      (ui i) (hui i))).left) 1 (α z)
